$comment: THE EDITABLE STORYBOARD. Story spine: LUNA generates the world as she sings — void, wireframe, material, full render, collapsed at the breakdown, rebuilt for the final chorus, folded back to a point at the end. `render_stage` selects each shot's world-state clause from RENDER_STAGES in build_shots.py; keep the arc in order when editing. 24 shots cut to the measured 106 BPM / 60-bar grid in beatmap.json. Every start/end lands on a bar line. Edit action/expression/camera/caption; keep character_ref for consistency. Expressions are drawn only from the 9 in the LUNA character sheet. `lyric_lines` is generated by scripts/align_lyrics.py — do not hand-edit it. `caption` and lyric subtitles are two different things: captions are designed visual title cards, lyric subtitles come from lyrics/lyrics.srt. Where both fall on the same shot (e.g. S05), the caption wins and the lyric subtitle yields. Compile with scripts/build_shots.py.

defaults.style_suffix: anime cel-shaded, clean line art, K-pop MV aesthetic, neon backlight, cinematic lighting
defaults.negative: extra fingers, deformed hands, inconsistent hair color, changed outfit, text artifacts, watermark, multiple characters

shots.camera: extreme close-up on closed eyes, static
shots.action: her closed eyes fill the frame in absolute darkness; a single cursor-like point of cold light blinks once, and a thin line of light draws itself across one eyelid
shots.sync: no bass (0.12x) - nothing exists yet, the blink is the only event in the frame

shots.action: she stands alone in unrendered black; one glowing grid line draws itself across the floor beneath her feet, then stops, waiting
shots.sync: airy pad only - the empty grid is the point, hold it

shots.camera: extreme close-up on her eyes, static
shots.action: her eyes snap open on the last beat before the bass; reflected in her violet irises is the wireframe of an entire city waiting to be rendered
shots.sync: 1 bar - the eyes open exactly on 0:11.81, the bar line before the drop

shots.action: she throws one hand up on the downbeat and a render pass explodes outward from her palm - wireframe edges skin over with material in one expanding wave, the black void becoming a stadium around her
shots.sync: HARD CUT on the bass entry (+5.5 dB) - the render wave lands exactly on the drop

shots.camera: medium full shot, orbit around her
shots.action: the first dance hook; on each downbeat another section of the arena finishes rendering behind her - trusses, then LED walls, then the wet-floor reflections
shots.sync: 16.34 / 18.60 / 20.86 - one new part of the world completes on each of the three downbeats
shots.caption: LIVE AI

shots.action: she walks through a half-built city in profile; the street ahead of her is blank white canvas, and each building resolves out of it a beat before she reaches it
shots.sync: vocal-led verse - one building completes per bar, always just ahead of her step

shots.camera: close-up on her face, shallow focus
shots.action: she lifts one hand into frame and a world no one has seen blooms out of her fingertips - a whole miniature city unfolding in glowing wireframe, reflected in her eyes
shots.sync: the line lands on the bloom; the city opens on the downbeat

shots.action: seen past her shoulder: a film studio - lights, rigs, camera cranes, a green screen - strips back to wireframe and blows away as particles, leaving open sky where the set was
shots.sync: the set dissolves across the bar, gone by the downbeat

shots.camera: extreme close-up on her eye, static
shots.action: reflected in her eye an impossible image assembles itself - a city folding upside down into the sky, gravity inverted, finishing in a single beat
shots.sync: 1 bar - the impossible image completes on the beat and holds

shots.action: glowing prompt glyphs stream through the air around her and collapse one at a time into finished solid objects - a chair, a lamp, an entire staircase - as she watches them land
shots.sync: one object completes per beat, four to the bar
shots.caption: 那真的是我嗎？

shots.action: rings of countdown light tighten around her as the riser climbs; behind her the unrendered horizon floods with light building toward the drop
shots.sync: riser - the rings tighten continuously and the light peaks exactly at 45.77

shots.camera: full body hero shot, low angle
shots.action: on the chorus downbeat she points straight down the lens and the entire world finishes rendering at once behind her - full lighting, true reflections, volumetric haze, all of it arriving in one frame
shots.sync: HARD CUT on the chorus downbeat. First true peak (0.64) - the world completes on that exact frame

shots.action: the finished world at full scale - silhouetted dancers in formation, a crowd of lightsticks to the horizon; the picture spills past the edges of its own frame, more image than the frame can hold
shots.sync: sustained chorus energy, the crowd pulses on every downbeat

shots.action: her face alone, lit by something off-screen that keeps changing colour as new finished worlds render past her, one per beat
shots.sync: 1 bar - the colour on her face changes on each of the four beats

shots.camera: steadicam figure-8 through the stage, continuous, medium full shot
shots.action: one unbroken move through the arena; each time the camera comes back around to her the world behind has re-rendered into somewhere new - a neon street, a flooded temple, an orbital station
shots.sync: 4 bars, continuous - the world changes on each 1-bar pass, four different places

shots.action: her back to us, arms opening to a crowd of lightsticks; light wakes first, then sound made visible as rings rippling out over the crowd, then story fragments flickering awake across the whole arena
shots.sync: three waves on three downbeats - light, sound, story, in that order

shots.action: she stands where physics has stopped applying - the floor curves overhead and the sky lies below her feet - upright and completely calm inside the impossible geometry
shots.sync: hold the impossible frame steady; only her hair and the chains move

shots.action: she walks a corridor of tall screens, each showing a different world she generated; as she passes, the world on each screen steps out of it into three dimensions behind her
shots.sync: one screen steps out per bar as she passes it

shots.action: close on her face as a structure unfolds origami-like out of the air beside her, each fold snapping into place on the beat until it is a finished building
shots.sync: one fold per beat, the structure completes on the last downbeat of the bar

shots.action: the bass vanishes and the rendered world peels away from her in sheets - materials strip back to bare wireframe, the wireframe drifts apart into latent noise, and she is left standing in the static
shots.sync: bass 0.39x falling to 0.02x - the world strips back across the whole bar, vocal carrying alone

shots.camera: extreme close-up on her eyes, static
shots.action: everything is gone but her; in the empty bar her eyes lift to the lens and a single new grid line draws itself across her iris - she is starting the world again
shots.sync: 1:30 is the absolute instrumental floor (0.02x), vocal only. The new grid line lands on the last beat

shots.action: she regenerates everything in one sweep - the whole world snaps back in a single expanding pass, brighter and denser than the first build, backup dancers appearing already mid-move around her
shots.sync: HARD CUT. Highest novelty in the track (0.86) - the regeneration pass lands on that frame
shots.caption: LIVE AI

shots.action: film, music and animation wake as three towering render passes behind her - a cinema frame, a standing waveform, a cel-shaded sky - then the camera finds the crowd beneath them
shots.sync: loudest sustained passage. One pass wakes every 2 bars, the crowd arrives on the fourth

shots.action: close on her hands as she closes them around a floating point of light; when she opens them it has become a solid object, warm and real, resting on her palm
shots.sync: 3 bars - she closes on the first downbeat, opens on the last

shots.camera: hero pose, slow pull-back to wide
shots.action: she holds the final pose as the camera pulls back through every world she rendered tonight, each one still running behind the last, until the entire stack of them is in frame at once
shots.sync: track peak (bass 1.6x). The pull-back is continuous and ends exactly on the 2:09.54 collapse

shots.action: the whole stack of worlds folds inward and collapses to one point of cold light on the final hit; the point holds, alone in the black, exactly where the first blink was
shots.sync: HARD CUT at 129.55. Final transient 0.96 at 132.90 - the collapse lands there and the point holds to the end
shots.caption: See you on the next stage.
